sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/francismarionsumter/recreation/elmwood-recreation-area (calls it a 'Primitive campsite' and gives no site count or vehicle length), read 2026-10-21; the derived ~30 sites and 40-ft maximum came from note prose resting on a camper report, which the agency pages do not state, so both are cleared

note: Open-field primitive campground off Rutledge Rd (SC-857) north of McClellanville; a popular camp during deer and turkey hunts on the Waterhorn Hunt Unit and an SCDNR game check station in big-game season. A 40-ft Class A has been reported here by campers; dirt-road drive-in passable by normal vehicle. --Claude
summary: Forest Service (Francis Marion Ranger District) primitive camp, run by the agency: confirmed free (fees manual), year-round, 14-day limit, first-come (no reservation system; not on recreation.gov), vault toilets and potable spigot water, picnic tables and grills. Cleared the derived site count (~30) and 40-ft maximum, which the agency pages do not state. Hookups left as derived (page silent). No forest alert or road closure for Rutledge Road (SC 857). Note trimmed of field facts.
